name: Pivot
description: Pivots rows into columns: for every configured pivot value one column is created with a conditional aggregate over the value column, grouped by the index columns. The values list is required and fixes the output schema, so a pivot value missing from the data still produces a column.

index.title: Index columns
index.description: Columns that identify one output row.

pivotColumn.title: Pivot column
pivotColumn.description: Column whose values become output columns.

valueColumn.title: Value column
valueColumn.description: Column aggregated into the pivoted cells.

values.title: Pivot values
values.description: Pivot values to create columns for, in output order.

agg.title: Aggregation
agg.description: Aggregate applied to the value column per index group and pivot value.
